svg.title: A point chooses one member of a vertical family
svg.desc: The curves y equals x squared minus two, x squared, and x squared plus three all have derivative two x. At input one, their heights differ, but all three tangent gradients are two. The point one, four lies only on the curve with C equals three. Substituting it gives four equals one squared plus C, hence C equals three.
